repositories.name: webauthn
repositories.description: Web Authentication: An API for accessing Public Key Credentials

rationale: Normative strong public-key authentication standard with direct trust-system composition relevance
Controlled Identifier Documents are a VCWG deliverable with direct controller/key relationship relevance
DID Working Group repository for the Decentralized Identifier specification; foundational to DIF DID methods, DIDComm and resolver work and relevant to ToIP identifier/control semantics
DID ecosystem extension registry can affect resolver and DID-method interoperability without itself establishing method support

repositories.name: did-resolution
repositories.description: Editor's Draft: Decentralized Identifier Resolution (DID Resolution) 1.0 Specification

rationale: DID Working Group deliverable defining DID resolution and dereferencing; directly intersects DIF Universal Resolver and downstream discovery/resolution semantics
DID Method Rubric evolution is governance/evaluation context relevant to DID method assessment but is not a runtime dependency

repositories.name: vc-di-bbs
repositories.description: A linked data proof suite specification for BBS+ signatures

rationale: VCWG BBS cryptosuite work provides selective-disclosure and zero-knowledge disclosure capability

repositories.name: vc-di-ecdsa
repositories.description: Data Integrity specification for ECDSA using NIST-compliant curves

rationale: Data Integrity ECDSA cryptosuite is an interoperability dependency for implementations selecting W3C VC proof mechanisms
Data Integrity EdDSA cryptosuite is an interoperability dependency for implementations selecting W3C VC proof mechanisms

repositories.name: vc-recognized-entities
repositories.description: The Recognized Entities specification defines Verifiable Credentials for recognizing entities and the actions they perform.

rationale: VCWG work on cryptographically verifiable recognition of entities and actions intersects trust-registry, recognition and issuer/verifier governance concerns

repositories.name: vc-bitstring-status-list
repositories.description: A privacy-preserving mechanism to publish status information for Verifiable Credentials.

rationale: Normative privacy-preserving credential status and revocation mechanism
Normative authenticity and integrity mechanisms for Verifiable Credentials

repositories.name: vc-jose-cose
repositories.description: Verifiable Credentials Working Group — VC JSON Web Tokens specification

rationale: VCWG JOSE/COSE security mechanisms, including SD-JWT-related credential securing, materially affect VC interoperability choices across DIF and ToIP work

repositories.name: vc-json-schema
repositories.description: A mechanism to use JSON Schemas with Verifiable Credentials

rationale: VCWG credential-schema mechanism intersects DIF credential schema work and ToIP credential validation semantics

repositories.name: vcalm
repositories.description: An HTTP API for performing verifiable credential lifecycle management.

rationale: W3C-hosted VC lifecycle API work covers issuance, verification, presentation and management interfaces with interoperability relevance
